title: Tool-round probe: force one model tool round, then the tool_choice:none synthesis
notes: Not part of the scored casebook (the loader only reads cases-A..G). Run with --probe tool-rounds. Each item caps the agent at two model rounds (BAYBAY_MAX_MODEL_ROUNDS=2), so a tool_use answer in round 1 is followed by the final call with tool_choice:none and max_tokens 9000 that replays the thinking and tool_use blocks with their tool_result. Web search is a local stub (no network). Source reads fail closed (the harness passes a sourceFetch that refuses every host) and route lookups are not configured, so a read_source call returns an error tool_result. The gold only checks that an answer came back on the assistant route; the evidence is the provider calls recorded in results-<arm>.jsonl (request shape and response block types).
